tasks.title: Promote staged users migration into the live migrations tree
tasks.dod: the staged 01_create_users up/down migration applies and reverts cleanly against a fresh Postgres database

tasks.title: Implement the account-linking-by-verified-email invariant as a pure function
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm: same verified email under two methods resolves to one existing account; a payload with no verified email is rejected before any persistence call

tasks.title: Build the Drizzle repository for the users shadow table
tasks.dod: integration tests confirm findByEmail, findById and upsert-by-id against the live users table, including the UNIQUE(email) conflict path

tasks.title: Wire the Clerk SDK client and Svix webhook-signature verification helper
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm a validly-signed Svix payload verifies and a tampered one is rejected; Clerk client reads config from env with no secret committed

tasks.title: Implement the Clerk webhook route handler (POST /webhooks/clerk)
tasks.dod: handler returns 200 with the upserted User on a verified user.created/user.updated event, 401 auth.webhook_invalid_signature on bad Svix signature, 422 auth.email_required when no verified email is present, and redelivery with the same svix-id is deduped

tasks.title: Build the session-read helper with the synchronous create-or-fetch fallback
tasks.dod: unit/integration tests confirm: a valid Clerk session resolves to the local user row, creating it on the spot if the webhook hasn't landed yet (sad.md §11 risk mitigation); no session or an expired/invalid one resolves to a typed unauthenticated result with no data leaked

tasks.title: Implement the dashboard route handler (GET /api/v1/dashboard)
tasks.dod: handler returns 200 DashboardData with has_trips:false for a valid session, and 401 auth.session_invalid with details.return_to set to the originally requested path when unauthenticated

tasks.title: Implement the logout route handler (POST /api/v1/auth/logout)
tasks.dod: handler revokes the session server-side via the Clerk SDK and returns 204; a subsequent dashboard request on the same browser returns 401; a request with no active session returns 401 auth.session_invalid

tasks.title: Add return-to origin validation and the unauthenticated-dashboard redirect path
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm a return-to URL sharing this app's scheme/host/port is preserved and round-tripped after login, and any off-origin return-to value is discarded in favor of the default dashboard destination

tasks.title: Build the i18n message catalog and translate() helper
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm translate(key) resolves from en.json for a supported Accept-Language and falls back to English for an unsupported one

tasks.title: Build the new shared UI primitives (OAuthProviderButton, EmailInput, Button, LinkButton, Alert, Spinner, Header, EmptyState)
tasks.dod: each primitive has a component test for its documented states (incl. loading variants) and is registered in docs/design-system.md

tasks.title: Build SCR-01 Login screen, all 5 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading, error-sign-in-failed, error-email-required and redirected-sign-in-required exactly as screens.md SCR-01 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-02 Check your email screen, all 4 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading, resent-confirmation and error-rate-limited exactly as screens.md SCR-02 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-04 Magic-link invalid screen, all 3 states
tasks.dod: component tests cover default, loading and error-rate-limited exactly as screens.md SCR-04 specifies

tasks.title: Build SCR-03 Dashboard shell screen, both states, wired to the dashboard and logout handlers
tasks.dod: component tests cover loading and default/empty exactly as screens.md SCR-03 specifies; the header logout button calls the T8 logout handler and redirects to login

tasks.title: Write integration tests for the QG-1 security scenarios
tasks.dod: integration tests assert (a) two sign-ins with the same verified email via different methods resolve to one account, (b) a dashboard request after logout on the same session is denied, (c) an off-origin return-to param is rejected

tasks.title: Write e2e tests for the sign-up-to-dashboard and return-to happy paths
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e covers: sign-up reaches the dashboard, an unauthenticated dashboard visit redirects to login and returns to the originally requested page after sign-in, a fresh account sees the empty-state dashboard, and the shell falls back to English for an unsupported browser locale
